courses.subject: BASQ
courses.title: Beginners' Basque
courses.description: Basic communication skills in Basque (listening, speaking, reading and writing). Introduction to basic information on Basque culture and history. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.
courses.prereqText: Four semesters or equivalent of Spanish, French or another Romance language.
